datasets.name: b9cde6c2
queryLines:
WITH cur AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_dollarized_by_sku_day t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))),
     prev AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_period_over_period t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE status <> 'NOT_ASSESSED' AND (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))),
     tot AS (
       SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(net_list_cost) FROM cur), 0) AS cur_usd,
              (SELECT SUM(est_current_usd_list) FROM prev) AS cur_judged,
              (SELECT SUM(est_previous_usd_list) FROM prev) AS prev_usd
     )
SELECT ROUND(cur_usd * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS value,
       CASE WHEN prev_usd IS NULL OR prev_usd = 0 THEN 'No prior period to compare'
            WHEN ABS(cur_judged - prev_usd) < 0.5 THEN 'About flat vs the previous period'
            WHEN ABS(100.0 * (cur_judged - prev_usd) / prev_usd) > 999 THEN 'No prior period to compare'
            WHEN cur_judged > prev_usd THEN
              concat('Up ', CAST(CAST(ROUND(100.0 * (cur_judged - prev_usd) / prev_usd, 0) AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '% vs the previous period')
            ELSE
              concat('Down ', CAST(CAST(ROUND(100.0 * (prev_usd - cur_judged) / prev_usd, 0) AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '% vs the previous period')
       END AS target
FROM tot

datasets.name: f64fd34f
queryLines:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT 'Warehouse idle time' AS source_label, workspace_id, warehouse_id AS entity_id, 'warehouse' AS entity_kind,
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2) AS wasted, est_wasted_usd_list AS floor_value, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_warehouse_idle_minutes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Idle cluster nodes', dc.workspace_id, w.cluster_id, 'cluster',
         w.status, ROUND(w.est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), w.est_wasted_usd_list, w.window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_idle_node_ratio w
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster dc ON dc.cluster_id = w.cluster_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Compute burned on failed runs', workspace_id, job_id, 'job',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE), window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_failed_jobs_wasted_dbus
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Compute burned on failed statements', workspace_id, warehouse_id, 'warehouse',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), est_wasted_usd_list, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_failed_statement_waste
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Endpoints billed with no requests', workspace_id, endpoint_id, 'endpoint',
         status, ROUND(est_wasted_usd_list * (1.0 - 0.0), 2), est_usd_list, window_days
  FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_serving_endpoint_cost_status
),
eff AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN') AND floor_value IS NOT NULL
                   AND floor_value < 50.0 * window_days / 30.0
              THEN 'OK' ELSE status END AS eff_status
  FROM src
),
named_all AS (
  SELECT e.*, COALESCE(ws.name, e.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name
  FROM eff e
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = e.workspace_id
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT source_label, workspace_id, entity_id, entity_kind, wasted
  FROM eff
  WHERE eff_status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN') AND wasted > 0
),
named AS (
  SELECT f.source_label, f.entity_kind, f.wasted,
         COALESCE(ws.name, f.workspace_id, 'Account-level') AS workspace_name,
         COALESCE(dw.warehouse_name, dc.cluster_name, dj.name, ep.endpoint_name, f.entity_id) AS resource_name
  FROM flagged f
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace ws ON ws.workspace_id = f.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse dw ON f.entity_kind = 'warehouse' AND dw.warehouse_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_cluster dc ON f.entity_kind = 'cluster' AND dc.cluster_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job dj ON f.entity_kind = 'job' AND dj.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND dj.job_id = f.entity_id
  LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.compute_serving_endpoint_cost_status ep
    ON f.entity_kind = 'endpoint' AND ep.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND ep.endpoint_id = f.entity_id
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(wasted), 0), 0) AS value,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'Nothing flagged'
            ELSE concat(CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING), ' resources; worst: ', COALESCE(MAX_BY(resource_name, wasted), 'none'))
       END AS target
FROM named
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(workspace_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))

datasets.name: d4c77a22
queryLines:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_job, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), ' (', CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS n_job, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_job FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_job_reliability t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(job_id AS STRING) AS job_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(job_id AS STRING)) d_job ON d_job.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_job.job_id = CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))),
     checks AS (SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'lakeflow_job_reliability', 'Broken or flaky jobs', 'Failures'),
       (1, 'lakeflow_failed_jobs_wasted_dbus', 'Compute burned on failed runs', 'Failures'),
       (2, 'lakeflow_failed_runs', 'Failed job runs', 'Failures'),
       (3, 'lakeflow_never_started_runs', 'Runs that never started', 'Failures'),
       (4, 'lakeflow_succeeded_with_failed_tasks', 'Runs that \'succeeded\' with a failed task', 'Failures'),
       (5, 'lakeflow_job_duration_regression', 'Jobs running slower than usual', 'Slow & queued'),
       (6, 'lakeflow_job_queue_time', 'Jobs waiting on compute', 'Slow & queued'),
       (7, 'lakeflow_phase_cold_start', 'Cluster cold-start time', 'Slow & queued'),
       (8, 'lakeflow_retries_repairs', 'Jobs relying on retries or repairs', 'Hygiene'),
       (9, 'lakeflow_stale_zombie_jobs', 'Stale jobs with no recent run', 'Hygiene'),
       (10, 'lakeflow_jobs_no_timeout', 'Jobs with no timeout set', 'Hygiene'),
       (11, 'lakeflow_job_tasks_no_timeout', 'Job tasks with no timeout set', 'Hygiene'),
       (12, 'lakeflow_jobs_on_all_purpose', 'Jobs on all-purpose clusters', 'Hygiene'),
       (13, 'lakeflow_health_rule_coverage', 'Jobs with no health rule', 'Hygiene'),
       (14, 'lakeflow_job_ownership_orphans', 'Jobs with no clear owner', 'Hygiene'),
       (15, 'lakeflow_tasks_near_timeout', 'Tasks running close to their timeout', 'Hygiene'),
       (16, 'lakeflow_job_compute_pressure', 'Job compute fit', 'Compute fit'),
       (17, 'task_cluster_utilization', 'Task-level cluster utilization', 'Compute fit'),
       (18, 'lakeflow_job_oversized', 'Jobs on bigger machines than they need', 'Compute fit'),
       (19, 'lakeflow_pipeline_cost', 'Spend by pipeline', 'Pipelines'),
       (20, 'lakeflow_pipeline_idle_tail_duration', 'Pipeline compute left running after its last update', 'Pipelines'),
       (21, 'lakeflow_pipeline_update_failures_retries', 'Pipeline update failures & retries', 'Pipelines')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord
),
     tot AS (
       SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE status = 'CRITICAL') AS broken,
              (SELECT count_if(critical_rows > 0 OR warn_rows > 0) FROM checks) AS flagged,
              (SELECT concat('Worst: ', nm_job, ', ', CAST(consecutive_failures AS STRING), ' runs failed in a row')
               FROM r WHERE status = 'CRITICAL' ORDER BY consecutive_failures DESC LIMIT 1) AS worst_job,
              (SELECT concat('Worst: ', check_title) FROM checks WHERE critical_rows > 0 OR warn_rows > 0
               ORDER BY critical_rows DESC, warn_rows DESC LIMIT 1) AS worst_check
     )
SELECT CASE WHEN broken > 0 THEN broken ELSE flagged END AS value,
       CASE WHEN broken > 0 THEN COALESCE(worst_job, 'Nothing flagged')
            ELSE COALESCE(worst_check, 'Nothing flagged') END AS target
FROM tot

datasets.name: 7c2f1ad2
queryLines:
WITH checks AS (SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'query_top_by_cost', 'Top queries by cost', 'Heavy queries'),
       (1, 'query_provenance_by_source', 'Query traffic by source', 'Heavy queries'),
       (2, 'audit_self_cost', 'This audit\'s own query cost', 'Heavy queries'),
       (3, 'query_local_spillage', 'Queries spilling to local disk', 'Efficiency'),
       (4, 'query_shuffle_write_amplification', 'Queries shuffling too much data', 'Efficiency'),
       (5, 'query_pruning_effectiveness', 'Queries not pruning partitions/files', 'Efficiency'),
       (6, 'query_cache_coldstart', 'Queries missing the disk cache', 'Efficiency'),
       (7, 'query_failed_queries_daily', 'Failed queries per day', 'Reliability'),
       (8, 'cost_failed_statement_waste', 'Compute burned on failed statements', 'Reliability'),
       (9, 'query_failed_statements_grouped', 'Failed statements by error', 'Reliability'),
       (10, 'query_warehouse_pressure', 'Warehouse memory & concurrency pressure', 'Capacity'),
       (11, 'query_queuing_waits', 'Queries waiting for a warehouse slot', 'Capacity'),
       (12, 'query_workload_mix_hours', 'Query workload by hour of day', 'Capacity'),
       (13, 'query_task_statement_breakdown', 'Statement breakdown by task stage', 'Capacity')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord
)
SELECT count_if(critical_rows > 0 OR warn_rows > 0) AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat('Worst: ', check_title) FROM checks WHERE critical_rows > 0 OR warn_rows > 0
                 ORDER BY critical_rows DESC, warn_rows DESC LIMIT 1), 'Nothing flagged') AS target
FROM checks

datasets.displayName: overview:Biggest movers vs the previous period
queryLines:
WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_period_over_period t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE status <> 'NOT_ASSESSED' AND (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT nm_workspace AS workspace, ROUND(SUM(est_current_usd_list - est_previous_usd_list) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS delta_usd
FROM base
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY ABS(SUM(est_current_usd_list - est_previous_usd_list)) DESC
LIMIT 8

datasets.name: 6f6fa5a5
queryLines:
WITH q AS (
SELECT usage_date AS day,
       CASE day_state WHEN 'ok' THEN 'Ran fine' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN 'slow' THEN 'Ran slow'
                      WHEN 'skipped' THEN 'Skipped' ELSE day_state END AS state,
       count(*) AS resources
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_job.n, CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_job, COALESCE(concat(d_job.n, ' (', CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS n_job, COALESCE(d_pipeline.n, CAST(t.`pipeline_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_pipeline, COALESCE(concat(d_pipeline.n, ' (', CAST(t.`pipeline_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`pipeline_id` AS STRING)) AS n_pipeline, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_job.n, CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_job.n, CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_job, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_pipeline.n, CAST(t.`pipeline_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_pipeline.n, CAST(t.`pipeline_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_pipeline FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_daily_state t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(job_id AS STRING) AS job_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(job_id AS STRING)) d_job ON d_job.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_job.job_id = CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(pipeline_id AS STRING) AS pipeline_id, max(pipeline_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_pipeline GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(pipeline_id AS STRING)) d_pipeline ON d_pipeline.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_pipeline.pipeline_id = CAST(t.`pipeline_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
GROUP BY 1, 2
),
r AS (SELECT `state` AS s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(`resources`) DESC) AS rk FROM q WHERE `state` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `state`),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM r)
SELECT q.`day`, q.`resources`,
       CASE WHEN q.`state` IS NULL OR r.rk < 8 OR n.n <= 8 THEN CAST(q.`state` AS STRING) ELSE 'Other' END AS `state`
FROM q LEFT JOIN r ON r.s = q.`state` CROSS JOIN n

datasets.name: abfbd458
queryLines:
SELECT day, SUM(queued_at_capacity_count) AS queued
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(d_warehouse.n, ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_warehouse.n, CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.query_queuing_waits t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CASE billing_origin_product
           WHEN 'DBSQL' THEN 'Databricks SQL' WHEN 'SQL' THEN 'SQL' WHEN 'DLT' THEN 'DLT'
           WHEN 'INTERACTIVE' THEN 'Serverless notebooks' WHEN 'ALL_PURPOSE' THEN 'All-purpose clusters'
           WHEN 'JOBS' THEN 'Jobs' WHEN 'MODEL_SERVING' THEN 'Model serving'
           ELSE COALESCE(initcap(replace(billing_origin_product, '_', ' ')), '(unlabeled product)')
         END AS product, ROUND(SUM(net_list_cost) * (1.0 - 0.0), 0) AS usd
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_dollarized_by_sku_day t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 739088cb
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'overview_spend_estimate', 'Estimated spend, reference', 'Overview'),
       (1, 'overview_dbu_by_sku', 'DBUs by SKU, reference', 'Overview'),
       (2, 'overview_serverless_classic_split', 'Serverless vs classic split, reference', 'Overview'),
       (3, 'overview_daily_dbu_trend', 'Daily DBU trend, reference', 'Overview'),
       (4, 'overview_list_prices_raw', 'List prices, raw, reference', 'Overview')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord
